plan_review.notes: Alternative A retained after explicit human selection over the reviewer's minimal-surface and lazy-generation alternatives. Implementation adds a producer side-effect firing matrix, non-mutating proposal generation, observed-trajectory room certificate over one captured origin tile set, release+acquire same-poll handoff, stable egress episode target across interaction preemption, live target revalidation, deterministic total ordering, generation/selection confluence tests, and bounded perf/parking guards. The already-approved architecture requirement rejects keeping post-selector pseudo-arbitration.
